mapper.select: select * from order_refund and refund_order_no like concat('%',#{req.refundOrderNo},'%') and payment_order_no like concat('%',#{req.paymentOrderNo},'%') and status=#{req.status} order by id desc
select * from order_payment where order_no=#{orderNo} for update
select count(1) from order_refund where refund_order_no=#{refundNo}
mapper.update: update order_payment set refunded_amount=refunded_amount+#{amount},updated_at=now() where order_no=#{orderNo} and status='SUCCESS' and refunded_amount+#{amount} <= order_amount
update order_refund set status='SUCCESS',unique_refund_no=#{tradeNo},refund_success_time=now(),updated_at=now() where refund_order_no=#{refundNo} and status='INIT'
update order_refund set status='FAIL',fail_reason=#{reason},updated_at=now() where refund_order_no=#{refundNo} and status='INIT'
